scenarios.note: Disposable sum utility replaces the illustrative whitespace utility; real checks, independent reviewer, Jira intake and fake PR handoff.

Four actual OMP processes stage saved-filter UI, validation and documentation under one writer; execute unit and Chromium checks, independent review, guide plan/read/assessment and publication with verified actual model identities.
Real failing patch, failed check, blocking review, corrected SHA and exhausted recovery variant.

Kill coordinator after real Rust Mail commits a send but before the application records its response; restart controller and explicitly resume with one keyed external delivery and causal reply, no stale effects.
Busy/disconnected steering, keyed insertion across restart, contained child pause, explicit requirements adoption and browser controls are separate fault variants.
Provider-lost replies through the delivery workflow plus existing/absent/unknown fault variants in publication/Jira tests.
Real scheduler process scenario with dependency-provider and queue-order variants in domain tests.

Preflight and wrong/secondary model guards plus eleven real OMP provider-failure variants. Only explicit policy-approved compatible models become recorded replacement attempts; no candidate becomes ready from a model reply.

Actual OMP workflow refreshes onto an advanced target, preserves old evidence, executes new unit/browser checks and review, updates one PR, exposes current CI failure and rejects late old-revision success without starting agents.
Real research agents validate pinned source citations and missing/corrected artifacts with no coding evidence.

Adversarial imported ticket and delivered peer message encounter actual tool/API authority guards, existing cross-run identity rejection, whole-controller/provider containment and secret/output scans before valid simulated delivery.

Budget and cancel/retained-PR recovery combine with killed-harness cleanup proving exact ownership, foreign resource survival and durable container receipts. Pending hosted CI is excluded across restart using fake time; real active-tool Cancel remains terminal and retains its interrupted receipt.

continuationNote: The original invocation passed 38/39 jobs; seven matrix variants exceeded the macOS tmux socket path limit before any model request. The unchanged source/runtime/manifest matrix passed 11/11 at a shorter output root. Other receipts are identical. continued-from.json verifies 13,165 copied regular files; 35 stopped tmux sockets were excluded.
